comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening angle; PR-1825 rotates an angle-grinder guard toward an operator and reclamps it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires simultaneous coaxial driver restraint and jam-nut tightening; PR-1825 releases an over-centre lever, rotates a guard, and reclamps it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires three retained actuation cycles and bounded stop drift; PR-1825 requires guard orientation, flat lever, grinder pose preservation, and clearance.
comparison.reason: This is the closest objective pattern, but the candidate tests locknut-induced setting disturbance and cyclic stop retention, abilities the lever-clamped guard does not test.
